title: Reagan and Bill Paynter's 1974 sighting near Bakersfield

tellings.quote: while he was governor of California, his pilot was a guy named Bill Painter and they were flying in a Cessna near Bakersfield.

plain: Ronald Reagan, while he was governor of California, is said to have had a sighting in 1974 while flying in a Cessna, a small private plane, near Bakersfield, with his pilot, a man named Bill Paynter. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, and in this passage he sets the scene without describing what they saw.
